svg.title: Method pipeline: from a clicked point to a grounded LLM answer
svg.desc: The user's clicked point is the single input. Stage one is deterministic geoprocessing that builds a network catchment, retrieves four open-data layers over it (points, lines, buildings, population), and computes a structured spatial brief. Stage two feeds the brief, an editable persona, and the user's questions into the model's context window, which produces a grounded answer; answers feed back as conversational memory.

g.text: densities, building count and coverage, road density, per-resident ratios, etc.

svg.text: Open data: OpenStreetMap, GHS-POP, Nominatim. Open-weight models. No API key, no fine-tuning.
